description: A bearded man in red and gold armour and a conical helmet with a red band stands in a gold-trimmed chariot drawn by two dark horses, pointing a sword forward. Behind him spearmen and archers in scale armour and conical helmets press through smoke, with a fortified hilltop city with crenellated walls and towers at upper right and a river beside it. In the foreground, men in white kilts and blue-and-gold striped headdresses run and splash through muddy water, and no text, frame or visible wounds appear.
